g.text: Existing observations · DeepSeek · complete test sets
A: best observed means; repeated candidates can contribute. Five validation passes per completed round.
B: bubble area = fraction of test tasks. C: spawn events / all test tasks, including tasks that stay single.
BFCL search best is R31; the displayed supplementary test is R29. DROP search uses F1.
HLE has no complete search round; Qwen/MATH R2 is incomplete. They are listed in the accompanying data notes.
